text.feels_intro: How {name}'s slap marks feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:

{name}'s face: swollen and lopsided, the cheeks bruised deep purple, the skin split over the cheekbone and the corner of the mouth, blood at {his} lips and a trickle from {his} nose; one eye is puffed half shut. A smell of sweat and blood clings to {him}.

{name}'s face: clear and even again; nothing shows of the slaps.

head: {name}'s face stings hot and bright, the burn of the handprint pulsing in {his} cheek. {name} feels shock and indignity, cheeks flushed with more than pain, eyes stinging with sudden tears.
{name}'s face throbs and burns, swollen tight, and {his} ears ring from the blows. {name} is humiliated and torn between fury and fear, holding {his} head stiffly and blinking back tears.

{name}'s face is a pounding, swollen agony; {his} ears ring, {his} head swims and {he} tastes blood. {name} is dazed and close to breaking, words thick through swollen lips, flinching at the smallest movement near {him}.
{name}'s face aches dully and is tender to the touch, stiff when {he} chews or smiles. {name} is self-conscious and ashamed of the marks, keeping {his} face turned away.
{name}'s face is only faintly tender along the cheekbones. {name} still flinches when a hand is raised near {him}.
{name}'s face feels normal again. A raised hand still brings back a quiet, burning memory of the humiliation.

{name}'s back and buttocks throb with a deep, hot ache, and sitting or leaning back makes {him} wince. {name} is humiliated and resentful, standing rather than sitting and moving stiffly.

{name}'s back and buttocks are a pounding, raw agony; every step jars the swollen flesh and cloth scrapes the split skin. {name} is shaken and close to tears, unable to sit or lie on {his} back, trembling when anyone comes near.

{name}'s back and buttocks are only tender when pressed or sat on too long. {name} is wary of anyone standing behind {him}.
{name}'s back and buttocks feel normal again. Sitting down sometimes brings back a quiet memory of the shame.

{name}'s {part} is a swollen, pounding agony across the thigh; walking is painful and sitting worse. {name} is shaken and miserable, limping and keeping weight off the leg.
{name}'s {part} is sore and stiff where the bruises sit, aching when {he} sits or kneels. {name} is weary and moves with care.
{name}'s {part} is only faintly tender when pressed. {name} walks normally again.

, and it is too much. The slap lands on flesh already split and bruised black, a jarring, pounding blow that leaves {him} reeling: {his} head swims, {his} ears ring, cold sweat breaks out, and {he} can barely hold {reflexive} upright.
